title: Import unrepresented SRD prose regions flagged by the source-coverage gate
description:
Why: the eshyra-4a7.1 source-structure inventory found SRD prose regions that are genuine rules/lore content but are not imported as any record and are not covered by another 4a7 child bead. The coverage gate marks them known-gap against this bead so they stay visible instead of being silently ignored.

Regions (page refs are vendored SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf pages):
- Races chapter 'Racial Traits' intro (p3): the trait-category explanations (Ability Score Increase, Age, Subraces, ...).
- Equipment chapter prose: Getting Into and Out of Armor (p64; its Donning and Doffing Armor table is eshyra-4a7.3), Weapon Proficiency + Weapon Properties (p64-65), Improvised Weapons / Silvered Weapons / Special Weapons (p65).
- Monsters chapter creature-family lore headings (Angels, Animated Objects, Demons, Devils, Dinosaurs, Dragons Chromatic/Metallic plus the ten per-color dragon group intros, Elementals, Fungi, Genies, Ghouls, Giants, Golems, Hags, Half-Dragon Template, Lycanthropes, Mephits, Mummies, Nagas, Oozes, Skeletons, Sphinxes, Vampires, Zombies; template tables are eshyra-4a7.3).
- Magic Items 'Sentient Magic Items' creation guidance (p251-252: Creating Sentient Magic Items, Abilities, Communication, Special Purpose, Conflict; its roll tables are eshyra-4a7.3).
- Appendix PH-B pantheon prose (The Celtic/Greek/Egyptian/Norse Pantheon; deity tables are eshyra-4a7.3).
- Appendix PH-C The Planes of Existence prose (Planar Travel, Transitive Planes, Inner Planes, Outer Planes, Demiplanes).
- Appendix MM-B 'Customizing NPCs' (p395).

What to do: decide per region whether the content becomes rule records (like the gamemastering chapters), structured child data, or a documented intentional exclusion; then import accordingly and replace the known-gap rules in SRD_5_1_COVERAGE_RULES (packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sourceInventoryCoverage.ts) with real coverage. Follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
design: Decompose by independent parser/content boundary. Each child must follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md, add focused regression/audit coverage before parser changes, regenerate rather than hand-edit generated records, replace only its owned known-gap predicates with real coverage, and report generated record churn. The parent closes when every child is complete and no source inventory item remains known-gap:eshyra-4a7.10. eshyra-4a7.9 remains the document-wide final audit.
notes:
From eshyra-4a7.3 (table accounting): 8 additional items are now explicitly known-gap:eshyra-4a7.10 (62 -> 70 total), all belonging to this bead's unimported regions: the four Appendix PH-B deity table captions (Celtic p360, Greek/Egyptian/Norse p361) plus one caption-less deity column run ('Suggested Domains Symbol' p360) — NOTE these tables' deity-name and alignment/domains/symbol column blocks interleave ACROSS pages in extraction order, so reconstruction needs column-block stitching; the two Half-Dragon Template tables (Color/Damage Resistance p320, size/breath-weapon 'Optional' run p321) in the Monsters template region; and the 'Self-Sufficiency' downtime sidebar (p73) — a PROSE callout box whose body renders at table-cell height, so the typography inventory classifies it table-caption; it is prose, not a table.
eshyra-4a7.10.1 completed: 16 Races/Equipment guidance rules added; parent known-gap count reduced from 70 to 59. Remaining scope is children .2-.6.
close_reason: All child regions are implemented and source coverage contains no remaining known-gap:eshyra-4a7.10 entries.
